description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Report' class in the Opencart admin extension namespace. It implements methods for managing report extensions, including installation, uninstallation, and listing available reports within the OpenCart system.
external_files: CSS and JS assets from api/assets/

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing report extension modules, including listing, installing, and uninstalling reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main report extension page with the list of available reports.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a list of available report extensions with their status and configuration options as an HTML string.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a report extension, including language loading, permission setting, and registering the extension components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a report extension, removing permissions and deregistering components as necessary.
